liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Samson & Delilah** (1 review): The performance bristles with energy as Jerry finds the groove and runs with it [25]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): The reviewer considers this the best version of Ramble On Rose ever recorded [28]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Described as one of the most faithful and tender renderings of the song [25]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): The Dark Star to Other One transition is powerful, though only first verses are sung [23]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (1 review): Jerry is dancing wildly on stage during the performance of this song [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-12-31.145356.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 29 songs; 282 min [1]
- **gd1978-12-31.155425.AKG414omni.cm.koda.miller.t.flac16**: source not stated; 30 songs; 295 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1978-12-31.150571.akg.koda.miller.flac16**: source not stated; 30 songs; 295 min [6]
- **gd1978-12-31.151330.Betty.Board.Anon.Noel.t-flac16**: soundboard; 30 songs; 255 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [8]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalls the event as one of the best nights of their life [20]
- Bill Graham's entrance is described as an event that must be seen to be believed [21]
- Matthew Kelly joins on harmonica for the performance of I Need A Miracle [3]
- John Cipollina performs with the band on Not Fade Away and Around And Around [6]
- New Riders Of The Purple Sage opened the show, with Ken Kesey attending [31]
- The show is compared to Barton Hall, giving it a run for its money [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-12-31.145356.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (mounted on railing, right balcony, even with the soundboard)> Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UDXLII) [1]. Also: Patches from an AKG D224E source fill gaps in several tracks [1]
- **gd1978-12-31.155425.AKG414omni.cm.koda.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Dennis Koda; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 24, 2021; source: AKG 414 (Omni) > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell UDXLI) [3]. Also: Recorded front row center balcony by Dennis Koda using an AKG 414 omni microphone [3]
- **gd1978-12-31.150571.akg.koda.miller.flac16**: taped by Recorded front row center balcony by Dennis Koda; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 13, 2020; source: AKG 414 (Omni) > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell UDXLI) [6]. Also: Sony ECM-270 cassette master supplies patches for several tracks in the first set [6]
- **gd1978-12-31.151330.Betty.Board.Anon.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Recording by Betty Cantor Jackson; transferred by PCM source & transfer by anonymous Edited & Mastered (Adobe Audition) by Joe Noel November 02, 2020; source: Source: SBD Reel Master > Beta tape > Beta VCR > PCM [8]. Also: The recording is a patchwork of SBD, AKG 414, and FMMR sources [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead & Blues Brothers Winterland Arena 1978 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-blues-brothers-at-winterland-1978) [32]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Winterland Arena - December 31, 1978](https://www.dead.net/show/december-31-1978) [33]
- Poster by Stanley Mouse: [Grateful Dead "Blue Rose" Mouse/Kelley 1978 AOR 4.38 Final Winterland Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/906230/Grateful-Dead-Blue-Rose-MouseKelley-1978-AOR-438-Final-Winterland-Poster) [34]
